name: 89030 · N Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89030 (N Las Vegas) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89030 (N Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89030 (N Las Vegas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.
